or via phone by dialing 1-833-535-2199 in the United States or 1-412-902-6776 internationally, then asking to join the conference call for STERIS plc.
A press release detailing financial results will be issued after the U.S. market closes on November 4, 2026.

For those unable to listen to the conference call live, a replay will be available beginning at 12:00 p.m. ET on November 5, 2026, either at www.steris-ir.com or via phone. To access the replay of the call, please use the access code 2589658 and dial 1-855-669-9658 in the United States or 1-412-317-0088 internationally.
